# `app.graycard.setup`

A publicly discoverable photography setup. Opting in writes one of these to the user's own repo; its `registry` field links to a well-known discovery anchor so a shared backlink index (Constellation) can enumerate every published setup across the network without any backend.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/setup.json`
- **Lexicon version:** `1`
- **Definitions:** 1

<a id="main"></a>

## `main`

A publicly discoverable photography setup. Opting in writes one of these to the user's own repo; its `registry` field links to a well-known discovery anchor so a shared backlink index (Constellation) can enumerate every published setup across the network without any backend.

**Kind:** `record`
**Record key:** `tid`
